findings.title: Retain failed SQLite closes through cleanup and native-lock release

locations.scope: readOnly finally catches db.close error then loses the db object
negative finally catches db.close error then loses the db object
io is block-local in try; no retained DB owner shared with finally
undrained excludes SQLite owners; lock can be unlinked after a close error

counterpath: A copied DB opens successfully in readOnly() or negative().

The explicitly handled db.close() failure is captured in closeError; diagnostic and AggregateError/throw preserve the error text, but the actual db handle has no retained registry or caller-accessible retry/drain interface.
quota-harness catch drains its known browser/HTTP/child/fixture/promise owners; IO is block-local and absent from cleanup.

If every other owner is drained, final undrained becomes false and the own native lock is released although the failed-close DB owner was not explicitly closed. This is a source-level failure branch, not an observed product/runtime failure.
findings.impact: A future admitted harness would break its all-owned-resources-closed/lock-retention contract on its existing close-error path. Current Stage04 entry/admit are hard-disabled, so no target/native effect occurred.
findings.minimum_fix: Retain each actual opened DatabaseSync handle until close succeeds; expose closeAll()/hasOpenOwners()/receipt(), hold io in outer harness scope, invoke closeAll in final cleanup for success/failure, include actual retained DB owners in undrained before unlinking lock. Preserve original/sidecar checks and aggregate query/mutation/close/integrity errors; record rollback failures separately rather than fabricating closure.
findings.not_requested: No changes to positive authority, SQL mutations, case/request counts, deadlines, source schemas or the open Q15 DDL/index/NOCASE native scope.

qualification: No mutable Stage04 source changed; no DB opened/imported/executed. Primitive capability NoF is separate and does not hide adapter close/lock finding. Canonical DDL/index/NOCASE native scope stays open.
